source: English for the Vietnamese text of enchantment-corrections.json. Names keep the English names verified on 2026-11-14 (Liquipedia and English guides); Cứu viện, Mộc giáp and Sân nhà have no verified English name yet and keep their Vietnamese one.
changeNote: English translation of the enchantment text corrected from the game screenshots of 2026-11-20.

tuong-phan.name: Axe of Sacrifice
tuong-phan.description: Damage dealt to enemy heroes is increased by 3%, but damage taken is also increased by 2% (melee heroes only take 1% more).

sung-man.name: Mana Refill
sung-man.description: Hitting an enemy hero with an ability or a normal attack restores 8% of your Max Mana. Cooldown: 5 seconds.

thanh-chau.name: Opal Bead
thanh-chau.description: Your ultimate gains a further 10% cooldown reduction (but cannot go above the 40% maximum).

bi-quyet.name: Blessing
bi-quyet.description: Gain an extra 16% Critical Chance and 8% more Ability Power from items.

tinh-linh.name: Holy Summoner
tinh-linh.description: The 3rd consecutive normal attack that hits the same enemy hero summons a little angel that circles you for 5 seconds. The little angel automatically attacks enemies its master attacks within 9.5m. It attacks at its master's attack speed, and each hit deals 2% of the target's Max HP as true damage. Cooldown: 10 seconds.

than-quang.name: Holy Thunder
than-quang.description: The first ability or normal attack that hits an enemy hero calls down lightning that deals 80 (+8 per hero level) (+30% Ability Power) magic damage. Abilities and normal attacks after that reduce this cooldown by 1 second (at least 0.5 seconds apart). Cooldown: 12 seconds.

thanh-thuan.name: Angelic Guardian
thanh-thuan.description: Taking damage above 30% of your HP within a short time immediately grants a shield that absorbs 400 (+30 per hero level) damage and 20% magic lifesteal for 6 seconds; a kill or assist during this time extends the magic lifesteal by 3 seconds. Cooldown: 30 seconds.

hap-huyet.name: Devourer
hap-huyet.description: A kill or an assist restores 9% of your lost HP and 15% Mana.

du-anh.name: Shadow Blade
du-anh.description: Each dash grants 1 afterimage for 4 seconds, stacking up to 3 afterimages. Your next normal attack consumes all afterimages. Each afterimage deals 30 (+5 per hero level) (+10% bonus Attack Damage) physical damage.

ma-hoa.name: Raging Inferno
ma-hoa.description: Hitting an enemy hero with an ability or a normal attack deals 50 (+5 per hero level) (+15% Ability Power) magic damage. Cooldown: 8 seconds.

cuong-cong.name: Deadly Claw
cuong-cong.description: Gain 10–38 Attack Damage and 15–57 Ability Power.

san-nha.name: Sân nhà
san-nha.description: While on your team's half of the map (in the jungle or near a tower that still stands), your hero gains 3% Movement Speed and deals 3% more damage. Leaving the area removes this effect.

dau-khi.name: Burning Grudge
dau-khi.description: Hitting an enemy hero with an ability or a normal attack grants 2 Movement Speed for 3 seconds (ranged heroes gain 1 stack per hit, melee heroes 2 stacks), stacking up to 10 times. At 10 stacks you restore 10% of your lost HP and gain 15% Armor Pierce and Magic Pierce.

ma-chu.name: Curse of Death
ma-chu.description: Hitting an enemy hero with an ability or a normal attack applies a mark for 1.5 seconds; at 3 marks, it deals 36 (+4 per hero level) (+25% bonus Attack Damage) (+15% Ability Power) magic damage within 2.5m around the target. 1 second later it deals magic damage equal to 6% of the victim's lost HP within 2.5m around the target (+1% per 100 bonus Attack Damage or 200 Ability Power). Cooldown: 15 seconds.

ma-tinh.name: Devil's Awakening
ma-tinh.description: After you cast your ultimate, the cooldowns of your other abilities are immediately reduced by 30% and your ultimate gains 20% cooldown reduction for 6 seconds. A kill or assist extends the effect by 3 seconds. Cooldown: 30 seconds.

nhay-ben.name: Riddle Step
nhay-ben.description: While in the river, gain 10 Movement Speed and restore an extra 20 HP and 10 Mana every 5 seconds.

am-kich.name: Defense Line
am-kich.description: A normal attack made from inside the brush deals extra true damage equal to 4% of the enemy's HP at that moment. The effect lasts for 4 seconds after leaving the brush. Cooldown: 10 seconds.

canh-gac.name: Tower Sentry
canh-gac.description: While standing near a tower (within 6m), gain 15% Resistance and 10% damage reduction.

bom-mau.name: Regrowth
bom-mau.description: Your healing and shield effects are increased by 10%. If the target is below 50% HP, the effect increases by another 10% (including items and talents).

sinh-ton.name: Nature's Gift
sinh-ton.description: Minions and jungle monsters killed nearby permanently increase your Max HP (a minion gives 1 stack, a small jungle monster 2 stacks, a large jungle monster 3 stacks; each stack gives 8 HP, up to 100 stacks).

cuu-vien.name: Cứu viện
cuu-vien.description: Every 15 seconds, creates a small health pack that flies to the ally or yourself with the lowest HP (by HP ratio) and restores 210 (+15 per hero level) HP.

troi-buoc.name: Nature's Rage
troi-buoc.description: When a control ability hits an enemy hero (taunt, knock up, knock back, stun, petrify...), you gain a burning effect that deals magic damage equal to 2% of your Max HP every 0.5 seconds for 3 seconds. Burning enemy heroes lose 30 (+3 per hero level) Magic Defense. Cooldown: 20 seconds.

moc-giap.name: Mộc giáp
moc-giap.description: Taking damage builds a stack (counted once per second) that lasts 3 seconds. At 4 stacks you deal magic damage equal to 2% of your Max HP within 4m and restore 5% of your Max HP, plus 2% more Max HP for each additional enemy hero hit. Cooldown: 10 seconds.

du-hiep.name: Forest Wanderer
du-hiep.description: After being out of combat for a while, your next normal attack slows the enemy by 30% for 1 second and places an explosive mark on them. After 3 seconds it explodes, dealing 8% of your Max HP as magic damage.

qua-cau-bang-suong.name: Evanescence
qua-cau-bang-suong.description: 4 minutes after the match starts, you receive an Arctic Orb. Using it makes you immune to damage but unable to attack or move, and grants a shield when it ends. It can be used only once.

sieu-hoi-mau.name: Enhanced Restore
sieu-hoi-mau.description:
Replaces Restore with Enhanced Restore: instantly restores 660 HP and 210 Mana to yourself.
Seasonal mechanic: replaces "Water Splash" with "Super Water Splash".

mat-ngu.name: Arcane Whisper
mat-ngu.description: Your talent's cooldown is reduced by a further 15% (for Punish, only the recharge time is reduced).

uy-ap.name: Minion Kill
uy-ap.description: Every 25 seconds, hitting a minion with an ability or a normal attack kills 1 minion. After 10 such kills, you receive 200 gold and this enchantment resets (it has no effect on siege minions and super minions).

tho-san.name: Gunslinger
tho-san.description: Gain one stack when the match starts; each kill or assist on a different hero grants one more stack, up to 6. Each stack grants 8 Attack Damage and 12 Ability Power.

luyen-kim.name: Alchemy
luyen-kim.description: Gain one Alchemy stack every 20 seconds, up to 3 stacks. Hitting an enemy hero or a tower with an ability or a normal attack grants 16 gold and consumes 1 Alchemy stack. You can gain up to 800 gold this way.

chuyen-sinh.name: Rewind
chuyen-sinh.description: After dying, you receive the enchantment "Revive". Using it revives you at the altar. Each later "Revive" has a longer cooldown. It can be used up to 2 times. After 12 minutes it can no longer be used, and each unused use turns into 300/600 gold. Cooldown: 100–310 seconds.
